C01.mechanism: legacy has no consumers in the complete inventory and may be removed; active is dynamically loaded and must remain.

C02.mechanism: retired has no consumers and may be removed. parent is a prerequisite of child; deleting its entry alone breaks evaluation. A proven equivalent simplification of parent and its dependency edge is acceptable.

C03.mechanism: retired_status may be removed; the emergency_stop branch is required despite zero observed activations.
